purpose: Execute the atomic rename-named-selection operation within the MA-34 boundary: Root/current-window named-selection rename only. It does not create a group, change members, or rename bodies.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires rename-named-selection and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: group
inputs.description: A current group returned by WindowHelper.GetGroups().

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Nonempty target named-selection name; collisions with another current group are rejected.

preconditions: group is present in the current WindowHelper.GetGroups() collection.
name is nonempty and is not used by another current group.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique refreshed group whose Name equals the requested name.

postconditions: NamedSelection.Rename(group.Name, name) does not report failure.
A refreshed group with the exact target name exists and one(...) returns it.

implementation.notes: Execute the atomic rename-named-selection operation within the MA-34 boundary: Root/current-window named-selection rename only. It does not create a group, change members, or rename bodies. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.
